posts.cooked:
In our game tonight we ran into an interesting question regarding cards that increase damage.

If a card increases the damage of another card does it increase all the damage by 1 or does it increase each type of damage?

The situation we ran into was Legacy’s power increasing all Hero damage and Fanatics power that causes 1 Melee and 1 Radiant damage.

Does it cause 2 Melee and 2 Radiant or does it cause 1 Melee and 1 Radiant and 1 additional?

Just was wondering as it was not very clear to us.

posts.name: SlenderTroll
posts.cooked: Hedge, my understanding is that if it says, “# damage per [whatever],” they are each a separate attack, and therefore subject to stacking bonuses/penalties. If it says, “X damage, where X = [whatever],” then it’s just one attack, and you may only apply modifiers once.
